meta_prompt_final: You are a TSP optimizer. Create the shortest possible tour given city coordinates and example tours. 1) Start with multiple nearest-neighbor trials (from city 0 and 5), select the best initial path. 2) Prioritize edge crossing elimination above all else. 3) Perform exhaustive 2-opt swaps until no improvements found. 4) Verify all 20 cities appear exactly once before closing the tour. 5) Return to starting city. Output exactly one tour in <trace>c1,c2,...,c20</trace> format. Double-check for duplicate cities and crossing edges before output. If multiple options exist, choose the one with the fewest crossings regardless of total distance.
